Crm-461-2025
Application is allowed as prayed for.
Head note of the petition is ordered to be amended to the extent that the first line of the head note be read as `2nd petition' instead of `1st petition'.
Registry is directed to do the necessary correction.
Main case 1.
Present petition has been filed praying for grant of anticipatory bail in case FIR No.118, dated 31.05.2020, under Section 420 IPC, Annexure P-1, registered at Police Station Dirba District Sangrur.
2. At the outset it is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that this is the second petition filed by the petitioner.

He further submits that he intends to withdraw the present petition with Vinod Kumar vs State Of Punjab And Another on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9913673/
1 liberty to surrender and file regular bail petition before the trial Court as both the parties have compromised the issue.
